description: Canonical index of reusable Agent Skills. Each entry points to one directory containing a SKILL.md file and optional progressive-disclosure resources.

skills.name: accessibility-ux
skills.title: Accessibility and inclusive UX
skills.description: Design, implement, and audit accessible digital experiences using semantic structure, keyboard interaction, assistive technology, inclusive visual design, and WCAG-aligned practices. Use for UI reviews, design systems, forms, navigation, dialogs, and accessibility remediation.

skills.name: ai-integration
skills.title: AI application and agent engineering
skills.description: Design, implement, evaluate, and secure LLM-powered features, RAG systems, tool-using agents, and model-provider integrations. Use for model APIs, structured outputs, retrieval, prompt injection defenses, orchestration, evaluation, privacy, and cost control.

skills.name: api-design
skills.title: API design and contract engineering
skills.description: Design, document, implement, or review HTTP, RPC, webhook, and event-driven API contracts. Use this skill for endpoint design, integrations, schema changes, versioning, pagination, authorization, and API reliability.

skills.name: architecture
skills.title: Software architecture
skills.description: Design or review software architecture for new systems, major refactors, service boundaries, data ownership, technology choices, and migration plans. Use this skill when the task involves structural decisions or meaningful long-term technical trade-offs.

skills.name: backend-engineering
skills.title: Backend engineering
skills.description: Build, refactor, debug, or review production backend services, APIs, integrations, and background jobs. Use for Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, or other server-side applications involving business logic, persistence, identity, reliability, or external systems.

skills.name: code-review
skills.title: Code review
skills.description: Perform read-only, evidence-based reviews of pull requests, diffs, or repository changes for correctness, security, data integrity, compatibility, reliability, and test quality. Use before merging or releasing code.

skills.name: data-engineering
skills.title: Data engineering
skills.description: Design, build, validate, and operate reliable data pipelines, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, analytics models, and data contracts. Use for ETL/ELT, batch/stream processing, warehouse/lakehouse work, data quality, and governed data access.

skills.name: database-engineering
skills.title: Database engineering
skills.description: Design, query, migrate, secure, and optimize relational databases, especially PostgreSQL. Use for schema design, SQL, indexes, transactions, concurrency, data integrity, backup/recovery, and production migrations.

skills.name: debugging
skills.title: Debugging and root-cause analysis
skills.description: Investigate defects, failed builds, unexpected output, production incidents, and intermittent behavior using reproducible experiments and evidence. Use when symptoms are unclear, cross components, or require root-cause analysis.

skills.name: devops-cloud
skills.title: DevOps and cloud engineering
skills.description: Design, implement, secure, and operate cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines. Use for CI/CD, containers, deployment platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, release engineering, secrets, monitoring, and incident response.

skills.name: frontend-engineering
skills.title: Frontend engineering
skills.description: Build, refactor, or review accessible, responsive web frontends using React, TypeScript, and other modern frameworks. Use for UI architecture, component design, routing, forms, state, API integration, browser behavior, performance, and visual quality.

skills.name: mobile-engineering
skills.title: Mobile application engineering
skills.description: Design, implement, test, and release cross-platform or native mobile applications, including Flutter and React Native. Use for mobile UI, app lifecycle, offline behavior, navigation, permissions, push notifications, performance, and store readiness.

skills.name: observability-reliability
skills.title: Observability and reliability engineering
skills.description: Design, instrument, and operate observable software systems using structured logs, metrics, traces, service objectives, alerting, and incident practices. Use for production readiness, diagnosing failures, reliability improvements, and SLO design.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.title: Performance engineering and optimization
skills.description: Measure, diagnose, and improve application, API, database, frontend, build, and infrastructure performance. Use when latency, throughput, memory, CPU, bundle size, startup time, or operating cost is a material concern.

skills.name: product-specification
skills.title: Product discovery and specification
skills.description: Turn ambiguous product ideas into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, scope boundaries, and delivery plans. Use for feature discovery, MVP definition, stakeholder alignment, backlog refinement, and product change proposals.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.title: Security engineering and security audits
skills.description: Assess application, API, infrastructure, identity, dependency, and AI-agent security. Use for authorized security reviews, threat modeling, pre-release audits, penetration-test planning, and remediation verification.

skills.name: technical-writing
skills.title: Technical writing and documentation engineering
skills.description: Create, audit, and maintain technical documentation, READMEs, API references, runbooks, ADRs, onboarding guides, architecture docs, and release notes. Use when technical information must be accurate, usable, and maintainable.

skills.name: testing-strategy
skills.title: Software testing strategy
skills.description: Design, implement, and improve automated tests across unit, integration, contract, browser, end-to-end, performance, and security layers. Use for new features, bug fixes, regression prevention, CI quality, and flaky-test investigation.
